scope: One read-only object focus on the existing active_observation entry. Auto, explicit world normal or evaluated source triangle. One selected triangle, one initial view and at most one corrective view in a resident capture. No model or deployed settings changes.
endpoints: cold candidate and original public route
verified native PNG plus actual owner/depth/source and selected pixel
early success, blind underside, rotated holdout, enclosed/hidden, plan without image, focus isolation, interrupted same-generation resume, expired/replaced geometry

acceptance.unknown: no verified sample, exhausted budget, missing or hidden display

stop: Run the fixed baseline/candidate engineering checks, record all outcomes and close the batch. No retries of a registered formal slot, release or automatic next batch.
